t: Extreme Reactor energy generators are, by design, not tied to any particular power system that exists today in the world of Minecraft.$(br2)Energy is generated and then converted on the fly by the Power Taps when it is extracted from the internal energy buffer.
Extreme Reactor 的发电设备在设计上并不绑定 Minecraft 世界中现存的任何特定供能系统。$(br2)能量先被生成，然后在从内部能量缓冲中提取时，由能量接口即时转换。

The Power Taps installed in your Reactor or Turbine define the output energy system of the machine.$(br2)Currently, the mod comes with a $(l:bigreactors/part-forgepowertap)Forge Energy Power Tap$(/l) that sends out $(bold)Forge Energy$() units.$(br2)Other power systems can easily be supported by adding new types of Power Taps.
安装在你的反应堆或涡轮机上的能量接口，决定了这台机器输出所使用的能量系统。$(br2)目前，本模组提供了 $(l:bigreactors/part-forgepowertap)Forge 能量接口$(/l)，可输出 $(bold)Forge 能量$()单位。$(br2)通过添加新的能量接口类型，也可以轻松支持其他供能系统。
